about: A08 shot list: a Snap it. spot (see episodes/A01-just-sign).

shots.name: a08garden
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in, no zoom, no cuts. At a lantern-lit wedding garden at dusk a stylized 3D animated photographer lowers her camera and smiles while three guests laugh over their phones. Small glowing lavender photo cards lift out of the guests' phones and drift in a thin ribbon of sparkle toward her. She smiles, delighted, and the guests wave. The room stays bright, warm and sharply lit with vivid saturated colours and strong contrast, never washed out, no haze, no fog, no mist, no fade, no glow bloom. Same faces, same clothes, same place, nothing morphs.

toast.title: New client upload - Wedding guest photos

shots.name: a08m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls back smoothly and quickly, up and away from the character, revealing the whole scene as a small cutaway diorama sitting on a pale lavender studio backdrop. Everyone stays exactly where they are, nobody walks, floats or grows. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve.

shots.name: a08diorama
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole diorama stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. On a small diorama of a wedding garden on a pale lavender backdrop, the tiny stylized 3D animated photographer holds a small glowing box while little glowing lavender photos float up from three tiny guests' phones into it; string lights twinkle. The diorama does not change shape. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Clean pale backdrop throughout, crisp, no haze, no fog. Feels light and satisfied.
